checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: Go/No-Go prompt must be trial-independent after the shape disappears

impact_assessment.why: The blank response window named the current trial (go: Respond to the circle; no-go: Do not respond to the square), letting a late response read the answer
impact_assessment.benefits: Response inhibition is measured from the shape, not the prompt; no information leak after stimulus offset
impact_assessment.risks: contract: prompt copy changes but timing, window, scoring and input unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first prompt-equality test, fixed-seed browser response-window playthrough with before/after frames and a late commission, full gates

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Fix: static Circles/Squares prompt in stimulus/response/feedback, Get ready in ITI; failing-first prompt-equality test and scripts/gonogo-prompt-proof.mjs added; before promptsEqual false, after true

[3/3] Verified: 390x844@2x before/after no-go response frames same seed/index; prompts differ -> identical; late no-go still commission; 29 Python + 250 Vitest, ai:verify 400/400, typecheck clean, aikit check 6/6; checklists: passed
[3/3 follow-up] Gate stability: batched study-journey block dispatches (12.96s -> 0.64s focused, 21.36s -> 9.46s full); assertions unchanged; rerun aikit check 6/6 passed
Task 'noesis-cycle4-gonogo-prompt' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: quick sessions must rotate the two-mechanic window so repeated short sessions cover all four tasks

impact_assessment.why: Quick sessions always took nback+gonogo; four fixed-clock runs recorded one pair and only 2/4 mechanics
impact_assessment.benefits: Reasoning and Speed Tap become reachable without changing the five-minute length; seed determinism retained
impact_assessment.risks: contract: quick lineup changes, standard/focus unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no storage change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first rotation test, fixed-clock four-session browser playthrough including one completed quick session, README update, full gates

[1/3] Plan: session header and result cards must show the block level, and completed results must record it

impact_assessment.why: Settings tells users to compare within level, adaptive changes levels, but headers/cards show no level and results do not store difficulty
impact_assessment.benefits: Adaptive changes become visible and auditable; blocks can be grouped by level in history/export
impact_assessment.risks: contract: MechanicResult gains optional difficulty and SessionView gains blockDifficulty; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: additive field, old records valid
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first engine assertions, UI level tests, fixed-clock adaptive playthrough with before/after frames, README update, full gates

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Fix: completeBlock records block difficulty; SessionView blockDifficulty; header shows Level L; result cards show Level badge; level test + scripts/level-visibility-proof.mjs added; README updated

[3/3] Verified: same adaptive seed/state; before headers no level/result null, after Level 1 N-back and Level 3 Go/No-Go in headers and cards; 29 Python + 253 Vitest, ai:verify 400/400, typecheck clean, aikit check 6/6; checklists: passed
Task 'noesis-cycle6-level-visibility' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: End session must ask for confirmation so a mis-tap cannot discard an unfinished session

impact_assessment.why: One click on End session in the pause overlay cleared the snapshot and aborted the session; scripted before-run went straight home with store null and snapshot false
impact_assessment.benefits: Recoverable accidental exits; no change to deliberate abort semantics
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI flow only, abort/snapshot unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: local confirmation flag
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first component test, fixed-clock pause/end browser playthrough with before/after frames and a keep-then-confirm run, full gates

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Fix: two-step End confirmation with Keep practicing; resets on unpause; end-confirmation test and scripts/end-guard-proof.mjs added; README documents it
